references.text: This is the specific verse Jesus quoted directly in John 10:34. Jesus argues that if Scripture can call those who receive God's word "gods," how much more can he, who is holy and sent by the Father, call himself the Son of God without breaking the law.

This is the text Jesus refers to when quoting directly. In Psalm 82:6 it says: "I said, 'You are gods, you are all sons of the Most High.'" Jesus uses this verse to defend that he cannot be accused of blasphemy for calling himself the Son of God, by showing that Scripture itself uses the word "gods" for those who receive God's word.
